messages:
elaine: Thanks everyone for a packed all-hands today — opening this thread for quick clarifications and owner follow-ups. I captured the key asks below.

ops-bot: Recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/ah/3141592653/recording · Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/3141592653/slides

maria: TL;DR doc uploaded and pinned. Added a short "unanswered during live" section.

noah: Question about Dedicated GA cadence — were targeting an "early Q3" GA delivered via staged canaries. Im owning the rollout checklist and canary gating criteria. Owner: noah. ETA: 2024-05-14.

sana: Observability/retention ask — customers want longer token-level cost history and trace retention. Ill draft retention tiers, estimated storage/cost impact, and a migration path. Owner: sana. ETA: 2024-05-06.

mike: Private deployment pilot — planning two pilot installs to validate KMS integration and upgrade playbook. Ill open the pilot board and list infra/security contacts. Owner: mike. ETA: 2024-06-03.

devex: SDK compatibility question — we keep major-semver guarantees; devex will publish deprecation timelines and short migration recipes (py/ts). Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-29.

maria: Compact action list (also in the follow-up doc):
```
- Noah: publish Dedicated phased-rollout checklist + canary gating (due 2024-05-14)
- Sana: observability retention tiers + cost estimate (due 2024-05-06)
- Mike: private pilot board + roster (due 2024-06-03)
- Devex: SDK deprecation timeline + migration snippets (due 2024-04-29)
- Maria: publish TL;DR & pin assets (done)
```

noah: Ack — will post the checklist and tag eng + product by EOD Mon.

sana: Starting a retention-cost calc and will link the draft here when ready.

mike: Opening the pilot board now, inviting infra, security, and support.

devex: Branching migration-examples repo and adding python/node snippets.

elaine: If your live question didnt get answered, reply here and well route it to the owner. If any ETA above is unrealistic, call it out now so we can re-prioritize. Thanks all for the fast follow-up! :rocket:
